title: Two Parts
author: Paulami Sengupta
text:
Self-doubt
The word has two parts.
The first, slim and desiccated.
The second, round and confident like R kakima, whom I met on a crowded train in January
A month before she was diagnosed and two months before she died.

The way to erase fear is to rinse.
A capful ofblue detergent being enough for a bucket.
Makes me think of copper sulphate and the teachers, who knew about this problem of mine
These overgrown bushes of anxiety.
Let me get the garden scissors.
